scope: Compact authoring/review dossier, final core calibration and identity, completed local native recall/VST3/controller/performance/sample-rate verification, and packaging/publisher fixtures, and the completed bounded pre-existing Program queue diagnosis. Final operating-system CI artifacts, remote release transaction, public download verification and the complete agent ledger remain integration-owned additions.
measurement_integrity: Existing 81 manifest entries are preserved exactly. No measurements were recalculated. Archived metadata removes the original checkout prefix only where present; the earlier final core log also abbreviates its producing Python runtime executable path. Original/stored hashes record transformations. Reproduction sources remain verbatim. Compact indexes identify selected and omitted supporting inputs. Historical draft, failed setup and unresolved observations retain their recorded stage.
limitations: Candidate parameter-override renders use the frozen baseline engine and baseline master volumes. They are not the final calibrated download.
Artifact-pipeline smoke uses the frozen baseline executable and cannot certify final CI assets.
Identity snapshot precedes later calibration and UFO Landing metadata correction; final identity review must account for both.
Character tests contain128 checks after window hardening; review/summary.json preserves the earlier116-check review snapshot.
Software behavior evidence is not acoustic-instrument equivalence, physical CS-80 calibration or a listening-panel result.
Final core integration passed four selected preset suites. Native-host, CI and download publication results are separate and are not certified by these local records.
Assignment-48 additions include completed local host and rendered-control evidence, not final CI or publicly downloaded operating-system packages.

Local final audition files identify source99f5ebd and run local-assignment-32. Archived local native checks identify be460b0. The superseding publication candidate is6d3cc220/run45044040694 after a test-fixture correction; run45042166237 was cancelled and no final CI/publication result is certified.
The older Linux post-SUCCESS crash is not fixed; a later diagnostic job rerun used different random seeds.
Native recall initial Xvfb wrapper failure also occurred with /bin/true; direct native fixture children subsequently exited0. Both observations remain archived.

The initial four-second ring observation failed six retirement checks; the final longer observation passes without changing factory settings or acceptance conditions. Both sources and results remain archived.

Assignment44 controller-plus-queue program selection/state restoration passes and its original queue-only failures remain unchanged. Completed assignment47 establishes a pre-existing controller-dependent queue limitation in bounded two-module Linux tests. Diagnostic completion is not queue-only selection success; no runtime fix, arbitrary DAW automation or exact older-binary compile commit is claimed.
Publisher installation at dd78677 and passing offline fixtures do not certify release permissions, real native artifacts, a successful upload or credential-free public downloads.
Embedded experiment SHA256SUMS files identify original payloads including omitted audio/state files; provenance.json alone is the inventory of this compact dossier.
